top_signals.title: Limited Threat to Nvidia’s Market Share: Futurum's Bulk
top_signals.summary: Futurum Group Head of Semiconductors and Infrastructure Rolf Bulk says recent developments at Nvidia could be incrementally positive for rival chipmakers but that outsized gains are unlikely. (Source: Bloomberg)
